episode_title: What universal free childcare is costing New Mexico
script_en: What universal free childcare is costing New Mexico.
A year ago, New Mexico became the first state to offer universal free childcare.
Parents who have successfully enrolled their children in the program say it's changed their lives.
But many families have yet to see the other side of a waitlist.
On this episode of The Sunday Story , NPR’s Julie Depenbrock reports on how the demand for childcare is outpacing providers’ capacities and the state budget.
Can New Mexico catch up and bring the program to the finish line?
